requiredFindings.title: Item 6 still declares O-1 open before declaring it closed
requiredFindings.detail: The current Configuration/discovery item retains: Open for C2: O-1, the TypeScriptConfigGraphV1 extendsResolved bound of 64 edges, which item 14a does not bound. Later in that same item it correctly says O-1 is closed by M3-B r10, S10b and B2-c2b. The first sentence is now false: r10 bounds item 14a, and the accepted implementation enforces it. This is a contradiction in the current remaining-work summary, not merely retained historical accepted evidence.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Remove the obsolete open-O-1 sentence or explicitly mark it as historical and resolved by r10/B2-c2b. Keep the correct closure sentence and remaining J1/C1/C4/J2b dependencies. Refresh the board pin and subject manifest.
